title: Claude Fable produced a counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture
summary: Claude AI produced a counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture, a famous unsolved problem in algebraic geometry that has remained open since 1966. This represents a potential breakthrough in both AI-assisted mathematical research and pure mathematics.
problem_solved: Provided a counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture, which if verified, would disprove a long-standing open problem in algebraic geometry
why_valuable: Demonstrates AI's growing capability to contribute to cutting-edge mathematical research and potentially resolves a 50+ year-old open problem
